flaws.description: Swapped both ax.plot(...) calls to ax.scatter(...), removing the line-only linewidth= and linestyle= keyword arguments since scatter does not accept them; this turns the two radial line series into scattered points.
Swapped the label strings between the two ax.scatter() calls so the legend now names the renewable-share series as 'Energy Efficiency Score' and the efficiency series as 'Renewable Energy Share'.
